text_block_list.text:
One day, when I went to the cafeteria, 
Transcend was gazing intently at a 
catalog.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa, seriously? You can go that fast?!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey, what do you think of this? Is it 
more effective than the usual one?

Checking the catalog, it turned out to be 
a well-regarded imported treadmill.

Its top speed setting is quite high, and I 
hear it's effective... However, it's an 
item I've never seen in person.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~ hearing that makes me even more 
interested♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Btw, is there anywhere in Japan where you 
can actually spend this?

I mentioned having heard of one installed 
at a privately owned gym, though I 
explained that it was quite far away.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see. Okaaay~♪ Thanks, Trainer-chan.

The next day, on my way back after 
finishing my errands...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-chan! Thanks for telling me 
about the gym!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Man~ that treadmill you mentioned was 
greatâª
choice_data_list: Don't tell me…… you actually went?
Don't tell me…… you actually went?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
You bet! The moment it crosses your mind, 
make your move! That's just how I roll, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Instead of sitting around overthinking it, 
wouldn't taking action feel way more 
refreshing?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It's like, I just can't sit still anymore, 
y'know?!
choice_data_list:
I want to learn from how easily you take 
action!
So, how was it when you tried using it?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Trainer-chan. It's my policy not to 
take on disciples...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Just kidding, of course. Honestly, there 
isn't really anything left for me to teach 
you.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I guess it's just, like, a natural trait I 
was born with? So if you wanna follow my 
lead――

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Just chase after my back! ...Ahaha, just 
kidding♪

If I ever hesitate on that very first 
step, I'll be sure to remember her back as 
she ran ahead.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Oh, naturally that'd catch your eye~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I knew you'd say that, so tada! I tracked 
our before-and-after data with an app♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
As thanks for showing me the gym, I shall 
give you a special demonstration~♪

The treadmill's effects were impressive, 
but what astonished me even more was how 
remarkably quick on her feet she was 
mentally.
